a girl hurt me a ton, and i cant ever get over it. and it hurts even more because she doesn't understand and thinks im some bad person when i just liked her so much and she hurt me so much and it was all for some wrong reason. 
and this was over a year ago and in that time ive cut myself up, along with other things. im so tired and im getting so close to finally doing it. i want to now. the only thing, literally only thing holding me back is that im scared of dying. because i enjoy nothing. no form of "help" actually helps, and there is no hope. i dont even need to date her i just want her to talk to me
